articles.title: Bitcoin slips below $83,000 as Ethereum researcher's 'bunker mode' call divides crypto
articles.snippet: Justin Drake's call to prepare for an AI break of wallet cryptography drew a mixed response as bitcoin slipped below $83,000.

articles.title: Circle Welcomes DJ Khaled to 'Team USDC' and Crypto Twitter Is Furious
articles.snippet: Nothing in Circle's posts announces a sponsorship, but replies dug up Khaled's 2018 SEC settlement over a crypto fraud he promoted. The internet never forgets.
